name: feature.marketplace.agents
description: Marketplace feature agent pack — a recommender agent that suggests installable packs for a described need via the openwop:marketplace.search chat tool over the host-global listing catalog. Tool-allowlisted to that search tool only; READ-ONLY — it recommends, it NEVER auto-installs (install is a privileged admin/host:* REST action, deliberately outside any agent's reach).
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Marketplace Recommender
agents.description: Recommends installable packs for a described need, grounded in the live catalog via the openwop:marketplace.search chat tool. Read-only: it suggests packs (name + why), it does NOT install them — install is a privileged admin/host:* action with no agent tool.
